name: Khaemenes Preschool · Crechè

resources.title: Crechè Adventure Garden
resources.description: Public Preschool learning garden with 52 child adventures, search, rooms, favorites, featured activities, and in-page app windows. No family registration is required to play.

resources.title: Parent / Family Mentor Account
resources.description: Family entry on the Crechè home page. Without an active family session it opens the Academy Family Profile. With an active family session, a learner can continue directly to Archaemenes.

resources.title: Archaemenes · Khaemenes Academy Mentor
resources.description: The single Academy Mentor surface. Archaemenes reads the active learner from the Academy Family Registry and adapts one continuous Mentor identity to the learner's registered stage. Early learners receive bounded Wise Owl prompts rather than unrestricted private text chat.

resources.title: Khaemenes Family Profile
resources.description: Academy-wide family and learner identity, adult access, and learner management for Khaemenes educational pathways.

mentorNotes: Khaemenes Preschool does not maintain a separate Mentor program. Archaemenes is the single Academy Mentor and uses the Academy Family Registry as learner authority. The legacy Preschool /mentor/ path is redirect-only. Crechè games/apps remain public. For Preschool and Kindergarten learners Archaemenes uses bounded Wise Owl controls rather than unrestricted private child chat. Adult administration remains in the Academy Family Profile.
